attributes.name: Split Cubes Raymarch
attributes.desc: Raymarched spinning split cubes with BPM-driven ticks (Shadertoy port)

attributes.name: Spot Exposure
attributes.desc: Adjusts exposure within a circular region

attributes.name: Square Break 3D
attributes.desc: Layer breaks into squares that zoom forward toward the camera as Progress increases. Each square scales up and flies out of the screen in true 3D perspective. No rotation.

attributes.name: S_Shake Ultra
attributes.desc: Nuclear-grade camera shake — 4-octave noise, 5 shake modes, frequency bands, shake decay/ramp, per-channel RGB split, X/Y/Z/Tilt with random+wave, organic handheld simulation

attributes.name: Starry Planes
attributes.desc: Port of Shadertoy 'Starry planes' with tone mapping

attributes.name: Star Tunnel
attributes.desc: Star tunnel with camera pose (XYZ + Rot XYZ) and auto motion-blur based on speed

attributes.name: Sway
attributes.desc: Distorts current layer with a wavy movement, adjustable direction and falloff.

attributes.name: Rotating Tiled Boxes Glow
attributes.desc: Procedural rotating tiled boxes with animated edges and colored glow (Shadertoy port)

attributes.name: Tritone
attributes.desc: Maps highlights, midtones, and shadows to three custom colors

attributes.name: Turbulent Pro
attributes.desc: Warp image using fractal noise (FBM) or curl noise, similar to Adobe After Effects Turbulent Displace

attributes.name: Twitch
attributes.desc: Shake-based blur with adjustable angle and amplitude

attributes.name: Lumetri Color Ultra
attributes.desc: Professional Lumetri Color grading suite — exposure, contrast, lift/gamma/gain, 5-point master curve, per-channel RGB curves, split toning, color wheels, creative tools, and film-grade output controls

attributes.name: Unmult
attributes.desc: Removes black backgrounds while preserving color and transparency. Includes threshold, feather, choke/spread, and edge blending.

attributes.name: VHS Suite
attributes.desc: Combined VHS and Glitch effects suite

attributes.name: Vortex Blur
attributes.desc: A vortex-like deformation. Strength, radius, and center can be adjusted.

attributes.name: Warp+
attributes.desc: Advanced warp engine with 12 warp modes, bend control, fisheye, barrel, pincushion, bulge, twirl, wave, ripple, spherize, and cinema-grade UV distortion

attributes.name: Warp
attributes.desc: Comprehensive warp effect with 15 styles including Arc, Bulge, Wave, and Twist.

attributes.name: Warped Noise Field
attributes.desc: Procedural warped noise with time animation. Approximates derivative-warped 3D noise.

attributes.name: Warped Grid
attributes.desc: A rotating and zooming grid texture with an optional warp effect.

attributes.name: Water Droplets
attributes.desc: Procedural water droplet ripples with normal-map sampling (Shadertoy port)

attributes.name: Water Waves
attributes.desc: Generates procedural water caustics and warps the layer content to look underwater.

attributes.name: Waveloq
attributes.desc: Waveloq LED dot panel. Black background with glowing neon dots. Dot size driven by image luma. Wave function distorts dot positions/sizes creating ripple patterns. 9 presets.

attributes.name: Wobble Rail Streaks
attributes.desc: Procedural wobbling rail streaks with patterned highlights (Shadertoy port)

attributes.name: Sharpen pro
attributes.desc: Bilateral denoise followed by unsharp mask. Port of Gemini's Shadertoy.
